learnerTasks.prompt: In a group of 33, 20 do activity A, 18 do activity B, and 9 do both. Find P(A or B) as a fraction in lowest terms.

A survey table records: group X with 16 successes and 20 failures; group Y with 6 successes and 16 failures. Find P(success | group X) as a fraction in lowest terms.
Two events have P(A) = 8/10, P(B) = 3/10, and P(A and B) = 29/100. Are A and B independent?
choices: No; the two events are mutually exclusive.
Yes; P(A and B) equals P(A)·P(B).
Yes; the two events cannot occur together.
No; P(A and B) differs from P(A)·P(B).
